text: A hosted instance follows its git remote: periodic fast-forward pull, live in open browsers
description: Felix 2026-11-01: a hosted (read-only) Aimparency should pick up what is pushed, by git pull from the server, ideally automatically. Nothing pulls today. On a hosted instance, every few minutes (AIMPARENCY_PULL_SECONDS, default 300, 0 = off): git fetch, then merge --ff-only from the upstream branch. Skip while .bowman has uncommitted changes (write accounts edit there and an admin commits by hand, af701cd6) and when history has diverged; log only when the outcome changes. After an update, emit idea/phase change events for the changed files so open browsers refresh and values recalculate. Never commits or pushes.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Pulling when someone opens the page keeps a public view current within seconds, without a fixed timer fetching for nobody.

status.comment:
backend/src/hosted-git-sync.ts: pullFastForward(.bowman) -> updated | unchanged | uncommitted-edits | diverged | no-upstream | failed. It skips when .bowman has uncommitted changes (readWorkingTreeStatus), requires an upstream, runs git fetch, fast-forwards only when HEAD is an ancestor of @{upstream} (merge --ff-only), and never commits or pushes; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, 120 s timeout. changeEventsFor maps changed ideas/*.json, phases/*.json and meta.json to the change events storage emits (deleted files flagged), so open browsers refresh and values recalculate. followGitRemote starts with the hosted server, interval AIMPARENCY_PULL_SECONDS (default 300, 0 = off), logs only when the outcome changes, and resets the migration check after a pull. Documented in the README hosting section and .env.example.

Evidence: hosted-git-sync.test.ts, 4 tests on real temp repos (bare upstream, author clone, server clone): a push is fast-forwarded with exactly ideas/gone (deleted), ideas/new and phases/p1 as events, and the src/ change is ignored; uncommitted server edits block the pull until they are gone; diverged history leaves HEAD untouched; a branch without upstream reports no-upstream; meta.json maps to a project event. pnpm check 25/25. Not run live: that would mean starting a hosted server, and it reaches the Commons Hub server on its next restart.
